description: Every SteveTheTroll test starts here: the arena spot (MIGRATION_DECISIONS C26), stt.reset (bed on the player's spot, hub closed, ghost trolls dropped, costume off, proximity watch on), no test trolls, and - unless switched off - the slippers on and HUB 1 25 m in front. clearMobs (default TRUE since 2026-11-09, agent24: every test starts in an arena without wild creatures and VERIFIES it; a test that needs a wild creature spawns it itself after this block): no wild creature within 80 m.

steps.name: stt.arena
steps.label: start on the arena spot (MIGRATION_DECISIONS C26)

steps.name: stt.clearMobs
steps.label: 2026-11-09 (full10: a wild Boar, full12: a wild Greyling started a guard chase in the middle of a fight test): the tests that fight or watch a fight start without wild creatures within 80 m

steps.name: stt.wildMobsNear
steps.label: precondition: no wild creature left within 80 m (the start is verified clean, not assumed)
